reasons.text: The label photo is legible and reads model B0726Q, which is not on the recalled model list (B0726Y). Under the claim policy, a legible label showing a non-recalled model means the unit is not part of the recall.
The typed model B0726Y matches the recall list, but the legible label photo takes precedence over the typed model, so the typed value does not confirm the model.
No duplicate claims were found, so no fraud flag applies.
Date code 8/21 is in range and the purchase at a listed retailer within the sale window is eligible; these do not offset the model mismatch.
